Storage compartment: - Multiple storage compartments are located throughout the vehicle.
- Glove compartment is illuminated and may be cooled depending on trim.
- Central armrest includes a storage bin with optional wireless charger.
- Front doors include bottle holders and map pockets.
- Rear doors and seat backs also offer storage solutions.
- Luggage compartment has hooks, nets, and hidden space under the floor.
Power sockets: - 12 V power socket available in the front and luggage compartment.
- USB-C ports are located in the front console and rear seats.
- Some models feature high-power USB ports suitable for charging laptops.
- Use only approved adapters to prevent damage.
- Power supply is limited when the vehicle is turned off.
